questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 7 onwards, three pens are clearly visible on the board in a row.

The middle pen has its writing tip exposed at the bottom, while the left and right pens have their caps at the bottom. This means the middle pen is oriented tip-down, while the others are cap-down (tip-up).
All pens have translucent grey/black barrels and black components (caps or grips/tips).
The middle pen is uncapped, showing a bare writing tip, while the other two pens are capped.
The board moves steadily from left to right across all frames without stopping.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board throughout the movement.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is uncapped with its tip exposed, while the outer two pens are capped. This violates the condition that every pen must be complete and capped.
